specification.problem: Evaluate a balanced binary NAND formula on N=4 leaves (depth-2 tree, value NAND(NAND(x0,x1),NAND(x2,x3))) with a discrete-query quantum walk, using one phase-oracle query per walk step and majority vote on the readout.
specification.reconstruction_scope: One tiny instance: a 4-leaf balanced NAND tree with an attached tail, a discrete-time walk with oracle-dependent leaf behaviour, a scattering-style readout, and a majority vote. Outside scope: the arbitrary-formula algorithm (rebalancing, weighted trees, phase estimation, N^{1/2+O(1/sqrt(log N))} cost) and any proof of the stated complexities.

symbols.meaning: black-box phase oracle on the leaf register, placed once per walk step

symbols.domain: unitary on vertex, coin and ancilla registers

symbols.meaning: wave number of the incoming plane wave
symbols.domain: real, near 0 or about pi/4 (tuned numerically)

equations.label: NAND recursion
equations.description: Recursive value of the balanced formula; for N=4 f=NAND(NAND(x0,x1),NAND(x2,x3)).
equations.justification: Definition of a binary NAND formula; the abstract only names it.
assumptions: Balanced binary tree with N=4 leaves

equations.label: Leaf phase oracle
equations.description: The black box acts on the leaf index and marks leaves by phase. A placeholder is placed once per step.
equations.justification: Taken from the sketch's phase-oracle model; the abstract only says 'discrete query'.
assumptions: Oracle acts as identity on non-leaf vertices (controlled on a leaf flag)

equations.label: Walk step
equations.description: Shift S along tree edges composed with a per-vertex Grover/Szegedy-type reflection, with leaf behaviour set by one oracle call.
equations.justification: Sketch-based construction. The exact coin weights and leaf rule of the cited discrete-query walk are not given in the abstract.
assumptions: Coin vector phi_v is uniform over the edges at v for the unweighted tree

equations.label: Tail plane-wave initial state
equations.description: Incoming wave on the tail attached at the root, moving toward the tree.
equations.justification: From the sketch; the amplitude profile and k are tuned numerically.
assumptions: Tail vertices j=-L..0 are joined to the root

equations.label: Query count and readout
equations.description: T queries are used in total. A large reflected probability is read as f=0 and a small one as f=1. The threshold theta is set from simulation.
equations.abstract_quote: We present an O(√N) discrete query quantum algorithm for evaluating balanced binary NAND formulas
equations.justification: The abstract's O(sqrt N) query claim implies T=Theta(sqrt N) steps with one query each. The readout rule is from the sketch.
assumptions: Tail on the incoming side is the 'reflected side'

registers.name: coin
registers.role: direction: parent, left child, right child

registers.name: anc
registers.role: query ancilla and leaf flag for the oracle phase

specification.initial_state: Tail plane-wave state of eq_4 on the vertex register, with coin set to the toward-root direction and the ancilla in |0>. Preparing it needs standard-gate rotations, not initialize.

steps.description: Prepare the tail plane-wave state with standard gates.
Repeat T times: apply the oracle placeholder once, then the coin reflection, then the edge shift.
Measure the vertex register, flag the tail side as reflected, and estimate p_refl over repeated runs.
Take the majority of a constant number of runs as the value of the formula, and compare with eq_1 on the test instance.

specification.measurement: Measure the vertex register only. In Qiskit, bit i holds vertex-index bit i (little-endian). Classify the outcome as tail (reflected side) or tree side by index range.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate p_refl, compare with the tuned threshold theta, and take the majority vote over a constant number of repetitions.
assumptions: The N=4 instance is chosen by me because no scope was given
Walk details such as coin weights, leaf rule, k, L and T are my assumptions, tuned numerically
The arbitrary-formula algorithm is out of scope
missing_information: Exact discrete-time walk operator and leaf rule of the cited algorithm
Precise tail length, k, T and threshold
Rebalancing and weighted-edge construction for arbitrary formulas
Whether the true method reads out by reflection probability or by phase estimation
